sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production illustration for the existing clean comic medieval fantasy mobile game. Match the supplied reference: crisp dark espresso outlines, confident chunky silhouettes, 2 or 3 restrained hard-edged painted values, broad intentional highlights. Clean readable game art, not photorealism. No soft glow, blurry airbrush, plastic gloss, excessive filigree, tiny engraving, extra shadows outside the silhouette, text, letters, numbers, watermark, or UI screenshot. Input image 1 is STYLE AND COLOR DEPTH reference only: the approved shop environment, warm wood, stone, saturated blue details and a bright cool outdoor view. Create a DIFFERENT hero staging hall, not a shop. PORTRAIT 3:4 composition, almost frontal camera, a modest down-angle of the floor. Clear depth from dark oak roof beams and a narrow foreground edge, warm timber-and-stone midground guild armory alcove, and a sunlit BLUE arched rear window with distant castle roofs and pale sky in the upper-right background. A restrained navy-blue heraldic cloth hanging at the far left, a small wall rack with a shield and sword at the far right, one tucked low barrel by the wall. Balanced warm ochre wood, cool indigo cloth, pale stone and cyan-blue daylight. Simple readable shadows shape the room and floor, broad gentle light patch across ground, no volumetric sun rays. Keep the central LEFT character zone open in front of an understated warm wooden wall, a SEPARATELY rendered hero will occupy x=30%, y=65%; do not paint a hero. Low ROUND sandstone standing step on the foreground floor: its oval TOP-SURFACE CENTER at x=30%, y=84% of the canvas, its width about 34% of canvas. Only short 8cm front riser, entire step fits inside image with margin, boots will be placed on its top. RIGHT middle zone will receive equipment UI so do not put huge objects there, but make edge framing and warm/cool separation attractive. Background top third should contain actual architectural depth, not a single empty flat gray wall. Lower 25% has real floor perspective and the dais; only upper-screen environment is wanted, no inventory region. No shop counter, no giant throne, no altar, no full wall monochrome, no characters, no floating objects, no interface or frame.

edit.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Preserve this generated warm clean comic fantasy guild staging hall EXACTLY: same wood walls and beams, blue banners, right blue window and distant castle, right shield/sword, barrel, lighting, floor and camera. Change ONLY the foreground ROUND STANDING STEP. It is currently too wide. Make the entire existing round sandstone step substantially smaller, with complete oval top WIDTH exactly about one third (34%) of the image width, and position its TOP-SURFACE CENTER at x=30%, y=84% of the image measured from upper-left. Height/front riser stays very LOW, about 8cm, do not add more steps. Preserve its clean circular/oval shape, material and restrained outline. Restore the underlying original perspective tile floor where the oversized old step was removed, so floor tiles remain continuous. The whole smaller standing step must fit comfortably with at least 10% side margin; no cropping, no tall altar. Preserve all architecture, props, exposure, style and palette; no new objects. Do not alter the overall scene composition or canvas 3:4 portrait ratio. No characters, UI or text.
